lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters are distributed in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. A notable sub-group of larger, high-luminance blobs is concentrated on the mid-lateral flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical alignments of high-luminance blobs form discernible vertical bands that intersect with horizontal rows, creating a visible grid of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, high-luminance biological signatures (remoras) are visible adhering to the ventral-lateral surface near the pectoral fin.
